label: Orders
description: Store single-seller commerce orders with immutable line snapshots and order status transitions.

instructions: Apply the bundled Supabase schema and Edge Function to the configured project.
Create a dedicated bearer token and install it in both the CMS secret store and the Supabase function secrets.
Install the orders source and dashboard backed by the deployed function URL.
checks: One order belongs to exactly one seller; multi-seller checkout must create multiple orders.
Orders does not own payment, delivery, stock, reservation, tax, discount or pricing engines.
Line amounts are frozen snapshots in the smallest currency unit.
The connector schema stays private to anon and authenticated Supabase roles.
resources: Generated private CMS orders API key
Private orders schema and Edge Function
review: Use immutable line snapshots so historical orders survive catalogue changes.
Do not expose Supabase service-role keys or generated CMS API keys to browser code.
Create one order per seller when checkout contains items from multiple sellers.
ui.syncNote: This integration creates a stateless CMS source. Supabase owns order rows; external integrations own payment, delivery, stock, reservation, tax and discount behavior.
